reserveReview.rationale: Reviewed 2026-09-21. Forte's current transparency page states that AUDF is fully backed 1:1 by Australian dollar reserves held with regulated financial institutions. Horizon Nexus (Audit) Pty Ltd audited the complete AUDF reserve bank-account cash balance of AUD 5,142,851.53 as of 31 August 2026 and issued an unmodified opinion dated 7 September 2026 under Australian Auditing Standards. The report supports one 100% AUD bank-deposit slice. It does not identify the bank or reconcile token liabilities inside the audit engagement, so those matters remain custody and assurance limitations rather than unidentified reserve assets.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Horizon Nexus independent audit of the AUDF reserve bank-account cash balance as of 2026-08-31
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The complete reserve asset class is identified as an AUD reserve bank-account cash balance. The bank identity, provider concentration, account terms, and audit-level token-liability reconciliation remain undisclosed.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Management and Horizon Nexus describe one segregated, unencumbered AUDF reserve bank account in Australia but do not name the bank, disclose provider allocations, establish statutory bankruptcy remoteness or trust status for token holders, or state anti-rehypothecation / successor-custody terms. Binding terms deny holders a security interest or trust/fiduciary claim on reserves.
